mapper.select: SELECT FROM message m WHERE ((m.sender_id=#{userId} AND m.receiver_id=#{peerId}) OR (m.sender_id=#{peerId} AND m.receiver_id=#{userId})) AND m.status=0 ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM message m WHERE (m.sender_id=#{userId} OR m.receiver_id=#{userId}) AND m.status=0 ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT CASE WHEN m.sender_id=#{userId} THEN m.receiver_id ELSE m.sender_id END AS peerId, u.name AS peerName, u.major AS peerMajor, m.id AS lastMessageId, m.sender_id AS lastSenderId, m.snap_id AS lastSnapId, m.content AS lastContent, m.ctime AS lastCtime FROM message m JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = CASE WHEN m.sender_id=#{userId} THEN m.receiver_id ELSE m.sender_id END WHERE (m.sender_id=#{userId} OR m.receiver_id=#{userId}) AND m.status=0 AND u.status=0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM message newer WHERE newer.status=0 AND ((newer.sender_id=m.sender_id AND newer.receiver_id=m.receiver_id) OR (newer.sender_id=m.receiver_id AND newer.receiver_id=m.sender_id)) AND newer.id > m.id ) ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET status=0 WHERE receiver_id=#{userId} AND sender_id=#{peerId}
